template: pre-2024 small template (Oct-Sep axis; coloured boxes: gold harvest, dark red lean, blue rainy, green land prep/planting)

regions.name: National
regions.where: Whole country (no regional blocks or locator map)

harvest.name: Off-season cropping (gold harvest-coloured bar; whole off-season cycle)

planting.name: Land preparation, planting, and weeding (one bar)

regions.notes: Axis runs OCT to SEP. Rainy season drawn as Oct + May-Sep, merged. Main harvest drawn as Oct-Jan + Sep, merged.

assign.method: Single-region calendar: every region mapped to national.

transcriber_notes: Old small template: 13 labels (OCT ... SEP, OCT) on the 13 dashed month-boundary lines, so the first column is OCT. Lean box ends about half-way through Sep (cover ~0.48, counted). Planting is one combined land prep/planting/weeding bar Mar to about three-quarters of Aug. "Off-season cropping" is not labelled as a harvest; included in harvest because it is gold, unlinked.
